csv_scope_of_work: The Triangle West Transportation Planning Organization (Triangle West TPO) seeks a consultant team to develop a long-range, multi-modal corridor plan for the NC-54 Corridor through Research Triangle Park (RTP). The NC-54 Corridor is a critical transportation facility for North Carolina s Research Triangle region. The corridor study will focus on the segment of NC-54 between NC-55 and the North Carolina Railroad line just west of South Miami Boulevard in RTP. This area includes an interchange with I-885, the planned Triangle Mobility Hub, Hub RTP, an existing high school, existing and planned multifamily development and other major developments as part of the RTP 3.0 Vision Plan, as well as multiple high-injury segments and intersections. The primary project area will be the NC-54 right-of-way; however, connections to the corridor within a 0.5-mile radius will also be considered.
